path_base: User-configurable dataset root; paths use forward slashes.

policy.split_assignment: Preserved from the frozen source manifest; no reassignment or new random split.
policy.long_term_usage: Observation and descriptive analysis; not assigned to train, val, or test.
policy.related_groups: Group identifiers express reviewed related viewpoints, not independently verified physical camera locations.
policy.labels: Category labels retain their recorded review status; unreviewed labels are initial labels.
policy.privacy: Original source titles, private filenames, and machine-specific absolute paths are omitted.
